URL; (c) plan=yearly returns distinct cs_test_ session; (d) missing X-Device-Id → 400; (e) invalid plan 'lifetime' → 422; (f) GET /api/billing/status unknown device → {status:'inactive'}; (g) GET /api/billing/verify ?session_id=cs_test_bogus → 404; (h) Regression PASS: /api/analyze mode=text, /api/transcribe multipart, /api/history POST+GET scoped by X-Device-Id; /api/auth/apple + /api/auth/google 4xx on invalid tokens. Frontend web verified: /billing/cancel renders with testIDs billing-cancel-retry + billing-cancel-home; /billing/success without session_id shows error state + billing-success-done; /billing/success?session_id=... shows 'Confirming your purchase…' state during verify (screenshot confirms); desktop 1280x820 renders WebFrame with 'NARCCHECK AI' badge + 'See through the argument.' hero + feature list + phone frame; mobile 390x844 renders no WebFrame; paywall-purchase + paywall-close testIDs exist. HOWEVER two frontend bugs detected on /paywall at web: (1) the two plan cards ($8.99 Monthly / $60.00 Annual) do NOT render because the render tree is still gated on rcEnabled/packages.length checks that are false on web — only the sticky 'Continue — $60.00' button is visible, so users CANNOT select the monthly plan and the hardcoded $8.99 never appears in the DOM; (2) the 'Setting up secure payments… Please retry in a moment.' identityError banner shows on web even though RC is intentionally bypassed — this is misleading and reduces trust during review. These must be fixed before shipping web checkout.

ui_bugs.issue: On web (Platform.OS==='web'), the plan cards block is never rendered because the surrounding guards (!rcEnabled, packages.length===0, isLoading) all evaluate against RC state which is intentionally off on web. Result: only the sticky Continue CTA is visible — monthly plan ($8.99) cannot be selected and $8.99 is absent from the DOM. The IS_WEB branch populates monthly/annual via WEB_MONTHLY/WEB_ANNUAL but the JSX gates at paywall.tsx:221-283 ignore IS_WEB. Fix: wrap the plan-cards block in `IS_WEB || (!isLoading && rcEnabled && packages.length>0)` or short-circuit the RC gates when IS_WEB. Reference: /app/frontend/app/paywall.tsx:221-283.

The identityError banner ('Setting up secure payments… Please retry in a moment.') renders on web because RC never initialises (keys blank by design). Should be suppressed when IS_WEB. Reference: /app/frontend/app/paywall.tsx:285-292.

rca_of_issue: RCA for frontend paywall bug: paywall.tsx was originally RC-only. The web port added IS_WEB-gated data (WEB_MONTHLY/WEB_ANNUAL at L28-37) and an IS_WEB branch in doPurchase (L101-109), but the JSX gating that decides WHETHER to render plan cards (L221-283) was not updated. On web, rcEnabled is false (keys blank by design), so the branch '!rcEnabled → Subscriptions only available in the mobile app' is taken, which hides the plan cards entirely. The hardcoded WEB prices are therefore computed and bound to the Continue CTA (visible as '$60.00') but never rendered as PlanCard components. Fix is a one-line gate change: short-circuit the RC guards when IS_WEB. Reproduction: open /paywall in a web browser → observe only Continue button, no plan selector.
